title: Signal Blocks AI Agents From Reading Private Chats via Screenshots on Android and iOS
content_md: Signal has announced that it will restrict screenshots by default to stop artificial intelligence (AI) agents from reading private chats on Android and iOS devices, but conceded that the protection is "incomplete." The feature applies to agentic systems built into iOS 27 and on Android versions where the encrypted messaging platform can detect an AI assistant attempting to read the Signal
exclude_reason: Product privacy feature announcement about screenshot restrictions, not a vulnerability, incident, breach or substantive security advisory.
